dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a distinct concave curvature, fitting a smooth spline from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded profile with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin slopes upward at an angle of approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.15 units of longitudinal base width to 1 unit of vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white pitting and small depigmented lesions across the epidermal surface; visible horizontal linear mark across the mid-lateral section of the fin; minor irregularities on the lower trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast white speckling pattern distributed across the visible dark grey dorsal surface.
